visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three men are seated in a living room; a hand holding a KFC bag enters the frame. (2) A close-up reveals the waffle chicken burger, showcasing its thick layers of waffle, fried chicken, and bacon. (3) The men take large bites of the burger, showing various facial expressions from surprise to enjoyment. (4) The burger is deconstructed on a white plate, separating the waffle from the chicken and bacon components. (5) Additional salad, tomatoes, and a scoop of ice cream are added to the plate, transforming it into a gourmet brunch set. (6) The men point at the new plate and laugh, with one man gesturing widely to emphasize the transformation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo synthesizer BGM kicks in with an energetic male voice introducing the product. (2) A 'Pop' SFX triggers as the burger is shown, followed by loud collective laughter and excited shouting. (3) Crisp crunching sounds are heard as the men bite into the chicken, overlaid with fast-paced dialogue describing the flavor profile. (4) A 'Ding' SFX accompanies the deconstruction phase, where the speaking rate slows slightly for comedic timing, followed by rhythmic laughter. (5) The audio concludes with a final crescendo of collective laughter and a sharp cut in both music and speech.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comedic and highly interactive review of the KFC Waffle Fried Chicken Burger. By starting with a traditional taste test and then humorously 'reclaiming' the ingredients into a gourmet brunch plate, it emphasizes the absurdity of the burger's height while promoting the brand through engaging, relatable content.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features the KFC brand name, logo, and product packaging prominently throughout, with the creators explicitly naming the 'KFC Waffle Fried Chicken Burger'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses fast-paced social media editing with variety-show style subtitles to maintain high energy. The contrast between the 'messy' eating and the 'elegant' deconstructed plating provides the core comedic hook.
